en.help.mesh.heal_scan: Weld coincident vertices, remove duplicate and degenerate facets, correct inconsistent winding and patch simple planar openings up to 32 edges. Review the repair report and undo the operation as a single edit.
en.help.mesh.fit_region_plane: Pick a triangle to grow a region by normal angle and fit a construction plane to its surface. The report shows the RMS and maximum distances from the scan to the fitted plane.
en.help.mesh.fit_region_cylinder: Pick a cylindrical side patch to fit a solid cylinder. Adjust the region angle to include more of the side. Review its radius, height and radial error.
